slice: Post-build red-team of the final exact 22-file public Intake to Recommendations repair candidate before Lady Jessica seals or promotes it. Candidate digest: 1c8a07b7813105346422c24b5037a92d44a59374ba8abbd5d223f4ea22fc757a.
sharedContext: The live production review found that Intake could dead-end when anonymous submission was closed, Recommendations could expose a bakery/example fixture as if personal, anonymous visitors could inherit a ghost owner's Intake, copy repeated internal reasoning labels, and several dark-surface helper/link colors failed production-shaped contrast checks.

The candidate now lets an anonymous visitor complete Intake and carry a completed device-local draft into ranked Recommendations without claiming account custody. Signed-in account-capable submission still uses the account API.

The server no longer supplies the bakery fixture as a production personal result. With no account or completed browser Intake, Recommendations shows an empty personal ranking plus the general option catalog.
A clean anonymous Intake no longer falls back to member_dev-preview-user or any other ghost owner.

Recommendation labels were pruned toward ordinary language, and bakery-specific plan text was generalized. The exact personal-input boundary says either account-saved Intake or the Intake saved in this browser.

Verification passed: TypeScript, optimized Next production build, Intake-to-Recommendations handoff contract, public browser-handoff honesty contract, Intake legibility contract, desktop/mobile production renders, and axe WCAG 2A/2AA with zero violations on both routes. Axe left only gradient/pseudo-element contrast items as incomplete manual checks.
No provider, secret, billing, schema/RLS, production-data mutation, push, deploy, or alias promotion is part of this review packet.
Personally perform this review in the named existing seat. Do not create or delegate to a subagent, replacement persona, new chat, or new environment.
A dispatch is not a receipt. Return a terminal response that echoes the custody token and gives a GO, PATCH, or STOP verdict with evidence and unknowns.
knownGaps: Browser-profile Intake does not follow the visitor to another browser or device, disappears if browser data is cleared, and the page says so.
Account persistence remains dependent on the existing signed-in account path; this candidate does not add schema or cross-device custody.
General catalog options remain visible when no personal ranking exists, but are explicitly labeled non-personal.
Automated contrast tooling cannot resolve every gradient or pseudo-element background; rendered desktop/mobile evidence is therefore part of Lady Jessica's manual seal.
liveStrings: Finish the Intake and see your first ideas.
Saved only in this browser profile. Clearing browser data removes it, and another browser or device will not have it.
No personal ranking yet. Complete Intake to connect these options to your situation.

ENDER.vision: Judge the repaired Intake-to-Recommendations journey as a human visitor: clarity, warmth, hierarchy, natural language, and whether the device/account boundary interrupts the experience.
ENDER.pull: Attack the supplied strings and change summary for robotic phrasing, repeated explanation, buried primary action, button-versus-information confusion, and desktop/mobile legibility risk.
go: Return GO/PATCH/STOP for the exact bounded candidate and quote every string that still needs correction before release.
Verify that the no-account path feels like a usable first experience rather than a disabled demo or technical diagnostic.
Name any visual/manual checks Lady Jessica must reproduce from the four screenshots before sealing.
ENDER.momentum: Give the smallest release-blocking patch list; keep later polish separate.
ENDER.outOfLane: No code, new task, provider action, account creation, push, deploy, or production mutation.

BEAN.vision: Hostile-audit custody, privacy, claim honesty, state separation, and the risk of presenting example or stale data as personal advice.
BEAN.pull: Try to falsify the candidate's claims about browser-only custody, account saving, anonymous isolation, recommendation personalization, and automation boundaries.
go: Return GO/PATCH/STOP with release-blocking trust failures separated from later hardening.
Attack cross-user leakage, stale ghost data, false persistence, fake personalization, and accidental professional-advice claims.
Specify the exact browser or source proof Lady Jessica must reproduce for every remaining risk.
BEAN.momentum: Name the minimum rollback or halt condition for this bounded release.
BEAN.outOfLane: No implementation, legal conclusion, secrets, production mutation, push, or deploy.
